# Calisthenix-Lab

> Bilingual (FR/EN) educational site about calisthenics: definitions, benefits, and five fundamental bodyweight movements with execution criteria, common mistakes, regressions and progressions. Static HTML/CSS/JS, no account, no cookies.

## Pages

- [Accueil / Home](https://calurion-dev.github.io/Calisthenix-Lab/): définition, méthode en trois étages, bénéfices.
- [Les bases / Fundamentals](https://calurion-dev.github.io/Calisthenix-Lab/bases.html): cinq fiches techniques (pompes, tractions, dips, pistol squat, gainage).
- [Méthodes / Methods](https://calurion-dev.github.io/Calisthenix-Lab/methodes.html): neuf méthodes d'entraînement (circuits, rep & set, GTG, push / pull, street lifting, endurance, freestyle, EMOM, pyramide).
- [Statique / Static](https://calurion-dev.github.io/Calisthenix-Lab/statique.html): L-sit, planche, front lever — prérequis et teasing V2.
- [Dynamique / Dynamic](https://calurion-dev.github.io/Calisthenix-Lab/dynamique.html): muscle-up, handstand, transitions — teasing V3.
- [Intensifications / Intensification](https://calurion-dev.github.io/Calisthenix-Lab/intensifications.html): dégressif, tempo, pause / hold et temps de repos — quand les appliquer.
- [Alimentation / Nutrition](https://calurion-dev.github.io/Calisthenix-Lab/alimentation.html): l'assiette 50 % légumes et fruits, 25 % glucides, 25 % protéines et lipides.
- [À propos / About](https://calurion-dev.github.io/Calisthenix-Lab/a-propos.html): intention, disclaimer santé, crédits, mentions légales.

## Notes

- Content is original and educational, not medical advice.
- No tracking, no cookies, no personal data collection.
